abstract_sentences.text: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for text-rich graph machine learning tasks such as node classification in high-impact domains like fraud detection and recommendation systems.

evidence.anchor: increasingly used for text-rich graph machine learning tasks

abstract_sentences.text: Yet, despite a surge of interest, the field lacks a principled understanding of the capabilities of LLMs in their interaction with graph data.
abstract_sentences.transition_role: turns adoption into a knowledge gap

abstract_sentences.text: In this work, we conduct a large-scale, controlled evaluation across several key axes of variability to systematically assess the strengths and weaknesses of LLM-based graph reasoning methods in text-based applications.
abstract_sentences.transition_role: answers the gap with a factorized evaluation

abstract_sentences.text: The axes include the LLM-graph interaction mode, comparing prompting, tool-use, and code generation; dataset domains, spanning citation, web-link, e-commerce, and social networks; structural regimes contrasting homophilic and heterophilic graphs; feature characteristics involving both short- and long-text node attributes; and model configurations with varying LLM sizes and reasoning capabilities.
numbers: five grouped axes in the abstract
abstract_sentences.comparison: interaction modes, domains, regimes, text, models

evidence.anchor: axes include the LLM-graph interaction mode

abstract_sentences.text: We further analyze dependencies by methodically truncating features, deleting edges, and removing labels to quantify reliance on input types.
abstract_sentences.transition_role: moves from outcomes to input dependence

evidence.anchor: truncating features, deleting edges, and removing labels

abstract_sentences.text: Our findings provide practical and actionable guidance.
abstract_sentences.transition_role: frames the following findings as guidance

abstract_sentences.text: LLMs as code generators achieve the strongest overall performance on graph data, with especially large gains on long-text or high-degree graphs where prompting quickly exceeds the token budget.
abstract_sentences.transition_role: states the first result without accuracy values

evidence.anchor: strongest overall performance on graph data

abstract_sentences.text: All interaction strategies remain effective on heterophilic graphs, challenging the assumption that LLM-based methods collapse under low homophily.
Code generation is able to flexibly adapt its reliance between structure, features, or labels to leverage the most informative input type.
Together, these findings provide a comprehensive view of the strengths and limitations of current LLM-graph interaction modes and highlight key design principles for future approaches.

evidence.anchor: highlight key design principles for future approaches

abstract_summary.result_reporting: three qualitative numbered findings; no accuracy/token/sample/uncertainty values

result_inventory.comparison: five interaction variants on three long-text datasets.

result_inventory.claim: Hybrid LLM+GNN 在五个 long-text datasets 上 generally 最强。

final_judgment.single_storyline: 交互接口控制信息暴露与外部计算；Graph-as-Code 通过 programmatic access、token efficiency 与 executable computation 获得优势。（物理页4 §3.1；物理页16–19 §C–D.3）
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留接口定义、14-dataset Tables 1–3、Figures 2–4 deletion evidence 与三条 conclusion guidance。（物理页3–9 §3–§6）
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 模型规模、reasoning、token/latency、summary/random-adjacency controls、synthetic task、supervised baselines 与 exact templates 移至 Appendix A–G；完整审计依赖这些页。（物理页14–23）
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figures 2–4 使用 matched 2D deletion heatmaps，同坐标并置 modes，直接显示依赖方向、崩溃区与 token-limit divergence。（物理页7–9）
final_judgment.largest_gap: 接口比较没有统一信息可达集合；Graph-as-Code 可查询任意 DataFrame 行列，Prompting 仅接收预组装邻域，adaptive-reliance 因果归因仅部分闭合。（物理页8 Finding 6；物理页23 Template 3）
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 比较 agent interfaces 时，把实际 resource/access contract 与 policy quality 分开验证；补一组 matched visible nodes/labels/hops/tokens/actions 的 control。（物理页17 §D.1；物理页23 Template 3）
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 端到端生产可用性研究可以把资源差异纳入 treatment definition；机制、robustness 与跨接口科学归因仍需 matched-access control。（物理页17 §D.1）
